metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 CLI in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its build configuration in [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It supports all four actions, GEDCOM tree parsing and rendering, structured errors, and GEDZIP attachment handling.

The requested CMake build passed from `output/`. ZIP handling supports stored and deflated entries; encrypted, ZIP64, and other compression-method archives are rejected.
